description: Protected RPC pre-execution screen: decodes a Solana sendTransaction or EVM eth_sendRawTransaction call and returns allow, warn or block with reason codes. Heuristic screening — will miss attacks. Never forwards, broadcasts, signs or submits the transaction.

method.description: sendTransaction (Solana) or eth_sendRawTransaction (EVM); or send the call as request

params.description: The JSON-RPC params: the signed transaction first (Solana: base58 or base64 with { encoding })

request.description: The whole JSON-RPC call { jsonrpc, id, method, params }

name: rpc__screen
